'''Reridan Reksiss''' was an [[Actor/Legends|actor]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51||What to Scan}}</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51||What to Scan}} is set on the date 13:4:11, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> they made an appearance on a talk show called ''[[In the Political Pit]]'' at 1935.<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Reridan Reksiss was mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 51|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #51'']], an issue of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] [[HoloNet News (original website)|feed]]<ref name="HNN" /> that was published on [[April 11]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN51 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6401165|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=MattPeriolat|date=2002-04-11|time=6:19 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> The section that referenced the individual, titled "What to Scan,"<ref name="HNN" /> was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
